scope: All four catalog rows for year 14 CE; no location filter.
calendar: Julian; catalog uses astronomical year numbering, identical to CE for positive years.
quantity_warning: Magnitude is fraction of solar diameter obscured, not area; listed time is dynamical time, not local civil time.
inference: Catalog predicts no total or hybrid solar eclipse anywhere in 14 CE. Conditional conflict with literal totality assigned to this year; does not resolve meaning or dating of the ancient passage.
dependence: Catalog uses VSOP87 and ELP-2000/82; pre-1950 Delta T from empirical fits to historical records. Specific records not audited.
uncertainty: S118 estimates Delta T standard error as 0.8*((year-1820)/100)^2 seconds over 1000 BCE-1200 CE. This is Earth-rotation timing uncertainty, not a multi-year historical date interval. No uncertainty propagation performed.
